# JUnit Assertion Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > JUnit

## Overview

Implements advanced assertion patterns with JUnit 5, AssertJ, and Hamcrest for expressive and maintainable test verification

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [junit-assertion-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
junit-assertion-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@junit-assertion-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write fluent assertions with AssertJ
- Implement custom assertions for domain types
- Use soft assertions for grouped checking
- Configure Hamcrest matchers for complex conditions

## Technology Standards Applied

- **AssertJ**: Fluent assertion API patterns
- **Hamcrest**: Matcher-based assertion patterns
- **Custom Assertions**: Domain-specific assertion design
